summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the allegorical names and their order, stone counts, speaker distinctions, ability to enter versus seeing without entering, mutual non-separation, death-as-sleep imagery, and final negative counterfactual. The simplified edition’s compression retains these meanings. Reader-facing “servant” follows project policy. The notes distinguish working readings, editorial restorations, reported variants, and conjectures; the paragraph 3 garments choice and final verb-form disclosure agree with the supplied apparatus reports. Acceptance concerns fidelity and disclosure within the supplied materials, not authentication of unseen manuscript ink, independent verification of every reported XML reading, exhaustive collation, or a uniquely correct interpretation.
